name: cavemio-answer-paper
title: Answer Paper
description: Drag the paper’s bottom handle to shorten an answer or restore its detail.

cavemio.usage:
import { CavemioAnswerPaper } from "@/components/cavemio-answer-paper"; The short answer.

Your complete answer and supporting details go here.

}]} />
cavemio.accessibility: The bottom handle is a keyboard-accessible slider. Up/Left shorten, Down/Right expand, Home selects the shortest version, and End restores the full answer. Inactive content is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Reduced motion disables spring and word movement, blur, and scale transitions.
cavemio.previewNote: The demo reproduces the supplied video’s four prepared answer versions. The component displays caller-provided summaries; it does not generate AI text or make network requests.

props.name: levels
props.description: Required. Answer versions ordered from shortest to longest.

props.name: defaultLevel
props.description: Optional. Starts with the longest answer when omitted.

props.name: onLevelChange
props.description: Optional. Called with the selected answer level index.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: Optional. Background color of the paper.

props.name: paperRadius
props.description: Optional. Border radius of the paper.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Optional. Color of the answer text.

props.name: handleColor
props.description: Optional. Color of the drag handle.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Optional. Accessible name for the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional. Additional CSS classes for the root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional. Inline styles for the root element.
